doc: Patent 50-86-0067 (Leisnoi, Inc.; AA-8448-A/B; signed 21 Nov 1985, recorded Kodiak 25 Nov 1985, Book 77 p.131-144)
easements: An easement sixty (60) feet in width for that portion of the Kodiak Island Highway located in Secs. 3, 10, 11, 14 and 15, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian.
A one (1) acre site easement upland of the mean high tide line of Middle Bay in Section 16, T. 29 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian.
An easement for an existing road sixty (60) feet in width from the Kodiak Island Highway (FAS Route No. 391) southerly to site easement EIN 24 D9.

An easement for an existing access trail twenty-five (25) feet in width from the Kodiak Island Highway (FAS Route No. 391) to the mouth of the American River in Section 21, T. 29 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian.
A two (2) acre site easement adjacent to the Kodiak Island Highway (FAS Route No. 391) at the American River Bridge. Uses: those listed for a one (1) acre site easement.

A one (1) acre site easement upland of the mean high tide line in Secs. 3 and 10, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian, on the west shore of Kalsin Bay between the beach and the Kodiak Island Highway (FAS Route No. 391).

An easement twenty-five (25) feet in width for an existing access trail from site EIN 29d C4, C5, D4, in Secs. 15 and/or 16, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian, southwesterly to public lands located in Sec. 29, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian.
A one (1) acre site easement located in Secs. 15 and/or 16, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian, at the junction of trail EIN 29a D9, L and road easement EIN 29e D1, D9.

An easement sixty (60) feet in width for an existing road from the Kodiak Island Highway (EIN 6 D1, L) in Sec. 10, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian, southwesterly to site easement EIN 29d C4, C5, D4.

An easement sixty (60) feet in width for an existing road from the Kodiak Island Highway (FAS Route No. 391) in Sec. 11, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian, northerly, generally parallel to the bank of Kalsin Creek, to tidewater, on the shore of Kalsin Lagoon.
A one (1) acre site easement located adjacent to the Kalsin Lagoon at the terminus of trail EIN 32 D9, L, in Sec. 11, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian.

A two (2) acre site easement in Sec. 34, T. 29 S., R. 19 W., Seward Meridian, upland of the mean high tide line, on the shore of Isthmus Bay, abutting the State highway (FAS Route No. 391). Uses: those listed for a one (1) acre site easement.

An easement fifty (50) feet in width for an existing access trail from the end of road easement EIN 44e D1, L, near Sequel Point, in Sec. 20, T. 30 S., R. 18 W., Seward Meridian, southwesterly to public lands.

An easement sixty (60) feet in width for an existing road from the Coast Guard LORAN facility in Sec. 9, T. 30 S., R. 18 W., Seward Meridian, southwesterly to trail EIN 42 D9, L in Sec. 20, T. 30 S., R. 18 W., Seward Meridian, near Sequel Point.

An easement for an existing trail twenty-five (25) feet in width from Pasagshak Point Road (FAS Route No. 3911) in Sec. 35, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian, easterly, to public land in the Sacramento River Valley.
A one (1) acre site easement adjacent to the Pasagshak Point Road (FAS Route No. 3911) and trail easement EIN 48a L.
A one (1) acre site easement adjacent to EIN 44e D1, L in Sec. 20, T. 30 S., R. 18 W., Seward Meridian, near Sequel Point.

An easement twenty-five (25) feet in width for an existing trail from EIN 6 D1, L in Sec. 10, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian, northwesterly, generally parallel to the left bank of Small Creek, to public lands.
A one (1) acre site easement in Sec. 10, T. 30 S., R. 20 W., Seward Meridian, adjacent to EIN 6 D1, L at the trailhead of EIN 105 C4.
An easement twenty-five (25) feet in width for a proposed trail from the Saltery Cove Road (FAS Route No. 3912) in Sec. 1, T. 30 S., R. 21 W., Seward Meridian, northwesterly to public lands.
A one (1) acre site easement in Sec. 1, T. 30 S., R. 21 W., Seward Meridian, adjacent to Saltery Cove Road (FAS Route No. 3912) at the head of trail EIN 106 C4.

An easement twenty-five (25) feet in width for an existing and proposed access trail from the Kodiak Island Highway (FAS Route No. 391) in Sec. 34, T. 29 S., R. 19 W., Seward Meridian, southerly to public land.

An easement sixty (60) feet in width for an existing road from the Kodiak Island Highway (FAS Route No. 391) in Sec. 32, T. 29 S., R. 19 W., Seward Meridian, northwesterly to the State tidelands in Kalsin Bay.
A one (1) acre site easement upland of the mean high tide line of Kalsin Bay at the end of road easement EIN 109 D1, D9 in Sec. 32, T. 29 S., R. 19 W., Seward Meridian.
